rust_summary: every block state's facts and looks by its id, for client mods working off the main thread (`native_block_states`).
doc_summary: [block states](#block-states) for client mods, to keep and use on any thread: `native_block_states()` gives every block state by its id with its facts (name, air, fluid, light, outline, map colour, waterlogged, whether it collides), what its model draws on each side and the texture behind each sprite. Bundles need "hooks": @API:block_appearance@.
